question: Why does the Server1 Trixie PXE lane install but fail to boot cleanly from disk?
evidence: Redfish BIOS BootMode was later corrected to Uefi
Server1 one-shot DHCP generator still handed non-iPXE clients filename undionly.kpxe
Known-good LAN MAC PXE fragment uses option architecture-type 00:07/00:09 to hand UEFI clients ipxe-snponly-x86_64.efi
Run 89474b09 observed preseed handoff but never reached SSH first boot before manual inspection
decision: Treat first-stage PXE architecture as part of the bootability contract. A UEFI-required Debian lane must chainload UEFI iPXE, not BIOS undionly.kpxe.
result: Patch Server1 one-shot DHCP generation to use the known-good architecture split before the next destructive PXE run. If thumb-drive inspection shows no EFI System Partition or no /EFI/debian/grubx64.efi, this trace is the primary suspect.

question: Could the Server1 Debian preseed install onto or wipe the rescue USB?
evidence: Server1 boot firmware was Legacy/NIC-first while a verified Debian USB was attached
The preseed early_command wiped every disk returned by list-devices disk
The install target was a volatile name, /dev/sda
decision: Never wipe all installer-visible disks in this lane. Wipe only the declared install disk, require it to be non-removable, and require a size larger than rescue USB media.
result: Candidate preseed now aborts unless ${dictionary.physical_install_disk} is a non-removable block device larger than 100 GiB, then wipes only that disk.
